name: Gibohame ~Otto no Shakkin de Musuko ya Kanekashi ni Hame Mawasareta Bakunyuu Gibo "Yukimi"
original_name: 義母ハメ～夫の借金で息子や金貸にハメまわされた爆乳義母『雪美』
source:
"Am I speaking to Takashi Arishima? I'm Yukimi Arishima."
It was the first time I heard her voice. She was my stepmother, my dad's new wife.
Me and mom had escaped him years ago. He was an abusive bastard, and
since then we'd never met or spoken once. Now it seemed he was in the hospital.

"Um!" she said, "If you have some time, Takashi, can we meet?"
Something in her voice. Not too high or low, it got right in my ears.
I admit I was intrigued. I just had to see this woman who would grace my worthless father.
The intrigue lubricated my thoughts, and I felt myself getting horny.
"......I understand. Let's meet this Sunday."
My voice was soft. I hung up.
